records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The accompanying unaudited, consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP") for interim financial information and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X. These unaudited, consolidated financial statements contain all adjustments (consisting of normal recurring accruals) necessary to present fairly our financial position as of June 30, 2024, our results of operations for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, and our cash flows for the six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amounts for credit losses charged to expense, before recoveries, during each of the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 were $63 and $41 million, respectively, and during each of the six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 were $136 and $83 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Pre-tax compensation expense for stock compensation awards recognized in Compensation and benefits in our statements of consolidated income for the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 was $30 and $39 million, respectively, and for the six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 was $3 and $165 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Marketable securities valued utilizing Level 1 inputs include active exchange-traded equity securities and equity index funds, and most U.S. government debt securities, as these securities all have quoted prices in active markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The applicable margin from the credit pricing grid as of June 30, 2024 was 0.70%.
